scenes.title: The Man They Sent — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: At Forward Base Lantern, Major Calder Rhys prepares to guard a scientist he has already decided to dislike, while a dead frequency repeats a warning.
scenes.caption: Floodlights stop where the canopy begins

scenes.title: The Initial — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Dr. Ivo Maren flies toward a man he has not seen in fourteen years and chooses, with his whole composure, to say nothing.
scenes.caption: The helicopter follows the river into weather

scenes.title: Asset Orchid — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: The briefing should be simple. The scientist is not fragile, not impressed, and familiar in a way Calder cannot name.
scenes.caption: Maps, rain, and a man who looks past the camera

scenes.chapterTitle: People You Mean to Bring Back
scenes.title: People You Mean to Bring Back — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Captain Nia Okonkwo counts the living on the river staging and decides the ghost signal is not a bad radio.
scenes.caption: Two boats at the edge of the last mapped water

scenes.title: Scientifically Acceptable — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Ivo crosses a perimeter because the moths do, and Calder learns that curiosity is not the same thing as stupidity.
scenes.caption: Stone-winged moths cross a line the soldiers drew

scenes.title: What the Rapids Didn't Do — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Survey Lantern's camp contradicts its obituary. Lieutenant Sable Venn needs a biologist she does not want to trust.
scenes.caption: A camp the official file returned to the river

scenes.title: Look at Its Movement — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Glass kites hit at dusk. Ivo's eye saves the shot. Calder's hands save Ivo. Respect arrives disguised as anger.
scenes.caption: The canopy opens, and something transparent falls

scenes.title: Not on the Chart — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: The medic treats the wounded, watches a marriage work under orders, and tells Calder the truth about fear that stays quiet.
scenes.caption: A lamp, a graze, and a carving nobody agrees about

scenes.title: The First Stones — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: The causeway of Qalen-Sar rises out of the roots. Ivo almost says a name. The expedition enters the city.
scenes.caption: The first stones of Qalen-Sar, under the roots

scenes.title: The Same Knot — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Priya reads a glyph in which ask and finish are the same word, and watches Calder watch Ivo as if the disaster might not be linguistic at all.
scenes.caption: Shadow finds the knot the noon light refuses

scenes.title: Lullaby — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Root nuns sing a broken Keeper lullaby. Ivo's recording and Calder's salt each keep Jun alive, and neither man manages a clean thank-you.
scenes.caption: Kneeling shapes where the roots learned a song

scenes.title: Pencil Shavings — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Rain lifts Calder's blocker for one breath. A classroom tries to surface, and he cannot hold the face that would not cry.
scenes.caption: One breath of citrus where the patch failed

scenes.title: Ask It Something — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: A Mirror Hind wears Sable's posture and repeats her last order. Ellis asks it a question, and the mimic fails.
scenes.caption: A print that cannot decide if it is a hoof or a boot

scenes.title: Six Hours — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Rhee admits she sat on a Helix transmission. The six hours will choose the ridge for the fight still coming.
scenes.caption: A burst she kept in her pocket for six hours

scenes.title: Cardamom — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Ivo sleeps on his notes. Calder covers him with a jacket and calls it asset management, and only Nia is qualified to grade the lie.
scenes.caption: A jacket, a notebook, a pod of cardamom

scenes.title: Cache the Metal — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Harun goes down the Cistern Stair without his gun. The eels are guarding silence, and Pavel's voice is still on a bone stylus.
scenes.caption: Metal sings, and the water answers

scenes.title: The Gallery — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Ivo crosses a cracked span for a verb. The stone goes. In the collapse he tells Calder he has always been like this.
scenes.caption: The last panel holds the verb

scenes.title: Ivo — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: The classroom returns. Calder speaks the name he never used kindly, and Ivo goes still.
scenes.caption: Rain through the gallery, and a name

scenes.title: After the Name — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: In the broken mouth of the gallery, Calder tries to apologize for a cruelty he has only just sized, and Ivo refuses him a cinematic forgiveness.
scenes.caption: Rain through broken stone, and a silence that knows the word

scenes.title: Technically Correct — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Ivo takes a small, exact revenge that is neither kindness nor abuse, and Calder, disgusted with himself, likes the attention.
scenes.caption: A stylus case, a nickname, and the weather between them

scenes.title: Leave the Tent — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Scent-thieves fake heat-signals in two omegas; suppressants hold while protocol empties the tent of alphas, and Calder goes without bargaining.
scenes.caption: Gray ribbons in the wet dark, and a tent that must empty

scenes.title: The Laugh — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: On a miserable morning Ivo laughs for real, and Calder knows the word for what he feels and does not say it, lying so badly his team starts betting.
scenes.caption: A startled laugh in wet green light, overheard by the wrong man

scenes.title: Too Close — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Ivo notices the jacket-pattern, the tea, and Calder's jealousy misfiled toward Priya, then overhears one sentence at night that rearranges the debt.
scenes.caption: A jacket's weave, a cup's steam, a sentence not meant for him

scenes.title: Chapter 24 — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Chapter 24

scenes.title: Chapter 25 — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Chapter 25

scenes.title: Chapter 26 — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Chapter 26

scenes.title: Chapter 27 — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Chapter 27

scenes.title: He Doesn't Ask — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Calder keeps the silence Ivo asked for. The work gets cleaner. Ivo finds a mural of Wardens who gardened danger, and nearly breaks the quiet he demanded.
scenes.caption: Paint that remembers hands, not ranks

scenes.title: The Unfinished — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Partial people speak from the wrong angle and know their names. Hester wants mercy by translation; Ivo wants data; Calder looks at Ivo only as tactics require.
scenes.caption: Water holds the shadow weapons can touch

scenes.title: The Empty Side — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Ivo admits he misses being annoyed with love in it. Ellis and Sable share a careful first kiss. He almost crosses the camp; Helix’s flare answers instead.
scenes.caption: Two silhouettes learn a smaller bravery

scenes.title: The Break — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Helix assaults as a Vein-storm hits. The basin collapses and the team splits. Radios die into Pavel’s cadence. Nia does her job without yet knowing Ivo is gone from Calder’s reach.
scenes.caption: Stone forgets it agreed to be a floor

scenes.title: Say It — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Soldiers go missing in known patterns; Ivo does not. Calder searches anyway, finds him under falling stone, and pays in ribs and forearm to get him out.
scenes.caption: Smoke, glass wings, and a choice that costs bone

scenes.title: Don't You Dare — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: The scientist ends. Ivo says Calder’s name like a person, refuses the rally until Mateo promises a litter, and is left with years of badly kept love.
scenes.caption: Blood on stone and a name said properly

scenes.title: Day One — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: In a Keeper hall field hospital, Calder lies unconscious and stable if the word is kind. Ivo refuses a cot and reports the mission to a man who cannot hear it.
scenes.caption: Lamps, gauze, and a vigil that refuses furniture

scenes.title: Day Three — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Ivo breaks at Calder’s bedside: years of love, the rejection as fear, the plea to wake. He does not know Calder has been awake since the moths.
scenes.caption: A hand on a chest and a truth that finally speaks

scenes.title: Won — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Calder waited through the confession rather than steal it. Weak, smiling, he asks if he finally won. Ivo’s mortification becomes a hug that hurts and does not release.
scenes.caption: A joke returns, and with it the room where truth lives

scenes.title: Still Us — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Bandaged and newly honest, Calder and Ivo argue medicine against the map; both go down toward the Bell, still themselves.
scenes.caption: Dawn, a sling, and two men who have stopped pretending

scenes.title: Her Brother — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Leona parleys under a fig lintel: Cho rings at dawn; she will help stop him if the ecological record survives without teaching the ask.
scenes.caption: Rain, a white flag that is not white, two commanders who will not forgive each other cleanly

scenes.title: The Listening Court — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Priya walks the murals aloud; some Unfinished reclaim a scrap of name; she decides to break the weapon stanza in the official copy.
scenes.caption: Shadow, water, and names given back by halves

scenes.title: Lantern — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Pavel’s full warning still loops on the air; the rapids story dies; Hester votes to seal the Bell and hates agreeing with a major.
scenes.caption: Nineteen minutes, a dead friend’s voice, a vote that tastes like ash

scenes.title: The Mouth — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: In the Bell chamber Ivo maps vats, wheel, and cistern; a cure offers itself in his teeth; he sets his hand down, and Calder does not grab his wrist.
scenes.caption: Warm water, bone in the roots, a hand that does not ring

scenes.title: Cho — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: One-armed tactics in the Bell chamber; Nia runs the line; eels cut wrong on purpose; Cho reaches the striker.
scenes.caption: Metal-song, warm water, a cracked bell carried like a thesis

scenes.title: Half — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Cho strikes a cracked bell and the Marrow begins to finish him. The wheel is blown, Harun keeps his leg, and Leona leaves with the notes that cannot teach the ask.
scenes.caption: The striker lands, and the pattern begins

scenes.title: The Record — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: On the way out, Ivo tells Calder the truth he can live with: he does not forget the notebook or the stair, and he chooses him anyway.
scenes.caption: Bandages, a true record, and lights that offend

scenes.title: One Note Higher — Chapter Opening
scenes.description: Six months later the Vein hums one note higher offshore. Ivo says not tonight. The kettle boils anyway.
scenes.caption: Six months on, a kettle, a hum
